items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I said, oh, Macio, I'll go right over there, so about three days later I went to Hartford and got him.

ctx.x: I see. Well, just on the subject of the guys in the family that drink or did drink, what did you say about your own brother in Hartford.
I went and got him when Basie came in town. Said he was out and he told Macio to go get me because his brother ain't the same.
Well, wait a minute, which brother was it.
